P1.finding: The M53 188824491-cycle outside term has no same-lineage operator/category decomposition identifying the inherited contribution of the 24 M63 Linear modules.
P1.impact: M63 fixed-baseline savings cannot be subtracted from the M53 denominator; the apparent 8.260x/8.638x naive joint ratios are prohibited and not results.
P1.minimal_fix: Freeze the exact M53 outside-term decomposition and L24_inherited_inside_outside, then replace that exact inherited term with R24_M63 instead of subtracting a second baseline.

P1.finding: The 193728-byte local model fits temporal K4 for only 13 of 24 modules; 11 modules require 11760 to 98160 extra bytes.
P1.impact: The all-24 temporal opportunity cannot become a local-resident hardware or headline claim.
P1.minimal_fix: Add a proved spill/tiling/recompute architecture with explicit transactions and ports, or scope the temporal design to the exact 13-module feasible set and recompute the complete system ledger.

P1.finding: The model has no M63 RTL, numeric INT8 qualification, SRAM macro/port mapping, address-timed DRAM, VCS replay, synthesis, timing, power or energy evidence.
P1.impact: K1/K4 ratios are deterministic opportunity-model ratios, not realized accelerator performance.
P1.minimal_fix: Implement the selected feasible schedule, close numeric equivalence and accuracy, replay all ten traces through exact RTL transactions, then run macro-aware DC/STA/Formality and SAIF/PTPX.

P1.finding: Even zeroing all captured Linear work yields only a 1.3317x fixed-compute ceiling; also zeroing M39 noneligible-plus-QK yields 2.0411x, below the 3.2x/3.45x comparison targets.
P1.impact: M63 alone cannot supply the desired multi-x DATE system-performance story.
P1.minimal_fix: Close additional dominant categories under a non-overlapping full-network ledger and report ratio-of-totals against equal-resource baselines.

P2.finding: The producer receipt stores opportunity metrics under a key named headline even though every ratio is marked not_system_speedup and the contract forbids a DATE headline.
P2.minimal_fix: Rename that section opportunity_metrics in a future additive receipt; do not rewrite the sealed producer receipt.

P2.finding: The corrected result_r2 artifact retains a result_v1 schema string and shares a directory with a stale pre-overlap-guard result.
P2.minimal_fix: Use an additive r2 schema/release index that identifies the sole citable result and keeps the stale artifact quarantined.

P2.finding: The producer receipt records host-specific absolute paths for two external ledgers.
P2.minimal_fix: Package exact-SHA copies or a verified handoff manifest so the validator is portable to the Synopsys server without path rewriting.

admission.admitted: Exact-SHA all-24/all-10 packed-bit and deterministic serialized opportunity-model arithmetic, including K1/K2/K4, capacity and Amdahl kill gates.
admission.not_admitted: Temporal all-24 locality, additive M53+M63 savings, joint ratio, RTL performance, system speedup, headline, numeric accuracy, PPA, power or energy.
admission.next_gate: M53 same-lineage outside-term decomposition plus a capacity-feasible M63 RTL/system schedule with exact transactions and no overlap double counting.
